text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I got a fan letter! It said my race and 
live performance made them happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Very, very fantastic! Being cheered on 
makes me so happy, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's go meet this cutie right now 
and give 'em a big ol' squeezy hug~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Would you like a hug too, 
Trainer-san~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I desperately held back Taiki Shuttle as 
she tried to rush out of the trainer's 
office.
